The '''Typhoon-2 Submersible Vehicle''' was a [[Submarine/Legends|submersible]] craft that was available on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] around the time of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]]. This was an example of a typical craft available to rent at the [[Seabed Lodge]], located within the [[Fathoms]] complex in [[Wildwater City]]. These craft were rented to tourists so they could explore the surrounding oceans.

They were sometimes used for sinister purposes well as the enforcer [[Nollo Kanx]] would sometimes take victims on a submersible ride before dumping them into the trench [[Rako's Rift]] to be eaten by a [[Krakana/Legends|krakana]].<ref name="WHSV" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Typhoon-2 was designed by [[Paul Danner]] and [[Bill Smith]] for ''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1997]].
